content.text:
Implemented transaction handling for Changelist list_editable processing in django/contrib/admin/options.py.

Change: In ModelAdmin.changelist_view, the bulk-edit loop that saves each changed form (save_form/save_model/save_related/log_change) is now wrapped in `with transaction.atomic(using=router.db_for_write(self.model)):`. This ensures all list_editable changes commit or roll back together, preventing partial/unexpected database states on error. `transaction` and `router` were already imported.

Verification: scoped_tests passed (74 tests, admin_changelist selection, returncode 0).
